scientific_question: At exactly matched target-reassignment severity, using identical collections of disjoint four-row swap atoms, does crossing historical Split CIFAR-100 task boundaries change the path-level value of ER relative to swaps confined within tasks?

interpretation.analysis_role: optional outcome-informed but prospectively locked fresh-seed mechanism stress test

upstream.name: Mammoth
upstream.effective_task_mapping: With dataset_config=20tasks and class permutation disabled, internal task t contains unchanged global labels [5t,5t+5), hence task_id=label//5. Explicit task_labels derived once at buffer admission are used by the intervention.

intervention.historical_definition: stored replay row with explicit task_id strictly smaller than the current minibatch task_id
intervention.quadruple: two rows with unequal labels from each of two unequal historical task IDs
intervention.selection: counter-keyed random tie priorities; greedily form a maximum number of disjoint unequal-label pairs within each task, then greedily match pair pools from different tasks to the maximum feasible number of disjoint quadruples
intervention.within_task_swap: exchange the two target sources inside each of the two task pairs
intervention.across_task_swap: exchange the two task-pair target blocks, with a counter-keyed orientation bit
intervention.paired_probe: train on unchanged replay targets and, every 100 observations when eligible, compute unnormalized full-replay CE gradients for true, within-task, and across-task target views from one common parameter state

inference.primary_estimand: across_task minus within_task final task-IL average accuracy in percentage points
inference.primary_interval: two-sided Student-t 95 percent paired interval over 12 seed differences
inference.primary_test: two-sided paired Student-t test at alpha 0.05
inference.mandatory_secondary_estimand: across_task minus within_task final class-IL average accuracy
secondary_outputs: task-IL and class-IL accuracy matrices and trajectories
average incremental accuracy and backward transfer
eligible and ineligible replay exposure counts
descriptive common-state gradient norms, distances, dot products, and cosines

queue_prerequisites.policy: launch wait-controller immediately, but start no GPU process until both declared DONE sentinels authenticate as PASS
